notes: Authoritative record spec for the Bosmer PATH-divergent race. GATE TYPE = state-enum-gated (R7): rewards gate on PDV_State_BosmerPath (OldContract=0|LivingStory=1|Exchange=2|BanditRoad=3, fallback LivingStory) plus the active path's progress tier within that state. The PATH is the focus -- Bosmer is path-divergent, NOT race-package-plus-patron (PDV_RaceRewardBudgetLedger Focused Pass: Bosmer). The path is treated as the 'patron' for the R3 naming convention. PROGRESSION CURRENCY = event-gated bursty path signals (per PDV_Phase20BosmerNonHunterImplementationCosting.manifest.json), each routed once-per-day; the small honest piety pulse goes to the path's SCORING DEITY (Yffre for OldContract/LivingStory, Zen for Exchange, BaanDar for BanditRoad) to keep decay/neglect/creed honest. Broad worship is a STATE on PATRON_STATE_BROAD (R1), NOT a deity -- there is NO PDV_Deity_BosmerBroad. The broad lane is Y'ffre-interpreted: broad Yffre T1 fills the FIXED manager property PDV_Bless_Bosmer_Yffre_T1 (R2); broad Yffre T2 is the new PDV_Bless_Bosmer_Yffre_T2, capped at Faithful. Broad stays SOFTER than the active path family and is SUPPRESSED when a path is committed (R8). Bosmer OWNS ZERO new deity records (R5): Y'ffre, Z'en, and Baan Dar all REUSE existing NATIVE/tolerated records (create:false). Z'en != Zenithar; Baan Dar is tolerated (Bandit Road), already shared-reconciled with Khajiit. Kynareth-as-Yffre-proxy is tolerated broad-only flavor for V1 (no Bosmer record; Imperial owns PDV_Deity_Kynareth). Green Pact stays MODEST POSITIVE WEIGHTING, NOT a hidden compliance ledger; item-level Green Pact feedback waits for the PDV-owned tag layer (do NOT punish at item level). T3 recognition = V1 Survey/status text only. Player-facing text is ASCII-only and uses Skyrim ActorValue names. No magnitude exceeds ~12%. Themes: Old Contract = hunt/forest-kept/Green Pact (hardest, strongest, narrowest, most burdensome); Living Story = community/nature/storytelling; Exchange = debt/trade/Z'en; Bandit Road = road-survival/pariah-luck/Baan Dar. Four paths must have COMPARABLE felt richness.

ownsNoNewDeities: Bosmer creates 0 new deity QUSTs (R5). Y'ffre (06CB52), Z'en (06FA1B), and Baan Dar (06FA1C) are all reused existing records (create:false). Baan Dar gains Stance_Bosmer=TOLERATED via shared-deity reconciliation (no record creation). Kynareth-as-Yffre-proxy and any other pantheon-flavor gods stay broad-only inside the Yffre-interpreted broad-state lane; they get NO Bosmer record in V1. There is NO PDV_Deity_BosmerBroad and NO PDV_Deity_<Path> -- the four paths are STATE enums, not deities (R1).

stateGate.gateModel: STATE-enum-gated (R7). The active path is the focus ('patron' for R3 naming). Rewards gate on PDV_State_BosmerPath (which path) PLUS the active path's progress tier (T1>=Seeker 25, T2>=Devoted 50, T3>=Champion 85). Exactly ONE path is active at a time; the focused reward family mirrors SyncKhajiitEmphasisRewards/SyncKhajiitEmphasisFamily (one active focus; tier-gated grant/removal). Path-progress tier is measured by the path's scoring-deity piety tier (Yffre for OldContract/LivingStory; Zen for Exchange; BaanDar for BanditRoad).
stateGate.switchingNote: Destination-gated switching per Phase 9: Living Story one strong signal; Exchange/BanditRoad two signal days in seven; Old Contract three Pact-positive days and one re-entry cycle. Path switching is a design cost (forced reckoning / Old Contract renunciation); not authored here as a reward record. Old Contract is separate from PactBound, GreenPactCompliance, and LapsedFromPact (existing manager state).

neglect.neglectFlagSource: active-path scoring deity neglect flag (IsNeglectFlagActive on Yffre/Zen/BaanDar for the active path)
neglect.playerFacingText: Your path no longer answers. Stamina regenerates 5% more slowly until you walk it again.
neglect.designNote: GENTLE by default (R: 'Neglect: gentle'). One shared Bosmer neglect spell, keyed to whichever path is active. Neglect is distinct from creed-violation loss. The neglect BITE is reserved for forced reckoning / Old Contract renunciation, which are handled by the creed-loss + Green Pact systems below, NOT by a larger neglect magnitude. Day-to-day lapse is gentle drift; no item-level Green Pact punishment.

greenPactHandling.policy: Green Pact stays MODEST POSITIVE WEIGHTING, NOT a hidden compliance ledger and NOT item-level punishment (tag layer not ready).
greenPactHandling.positiveWeighting: Outside Old Contract, kept Pact practice (forest kept, restraint) contributes a small positive pulse to the path scoring deity via the forest-kept / nature-site favor routes (101/103). It is amplification, not a tracked compliance meter.
greenPactHandling.itemLevelDeferred: Item-level Green Pact feedback (plant food, plant potions, wood/lumber surfaces) WAITS for the PDV-owned tag layer. Do NOT author broad plant-detection punishment. Rejected: broad plant detection without reliable item evidence (manifest rejectedHooks).
greenPactHandling.oldContractViolation: Only on the Old Contract path does a Green Pact violation carry a real loss. This REUSES the existing wired manager model (HandleGreenPactViolation, scratch p2-toast-panel-fix PDV__ManagerQuest.psc line 1260): OldContract-only gate, AdjustBosmerGreenPactCompliance(-15) on a 2-day window, escalating PDV.Bosmer.GreenPactViolationCount, GreenPactPenaltyActive at >=5, plus AwardCuratedSignal(PDV_Yffre, SIGNAL_PACT_VIOLATION). The Yffre piety loss is the existing pact-violation -2.0 model. Do NOT recreate this; the spec references it.
greenPactHandling.designNote: Old Contract is the ONLY path where the Green Pact is a binding burden. Living Story / Exchange / Bandit Road carry only the modest positive weighting and never the -15 compliance hit or item-level scrutiny.

creedViolationLoss.policy: Medium/major only; 2-3 negative deltas. Distinct from gentle neglect drift. REUSES the existing Yffre pact-violation -2.0 model where applicable.

entries.reuse: existing Yffre pact-violation -2.0 model + HandleGreenPactViolation (-15 GreenPactCompliance, escalating)
entries.trigger: Green Pact violation while OldContract (eating plant food, defiling the forest in a tagged/curated context, breaking forest-kept restraint). OldContract-only per the existing manager gate.
entries.playerFacingText: You broke the Old Contract. Y'ffre's regard cools and the Pact tightens against you.

entries.trigger: Forced reckoning: sustained Green Pact lapse triggering the reckoning beat (GreenPactPenaltyActive). The neglect bite lands here, not in day-to-day drift.
entries.playerFacingText: The Pact has come due. What was kept is no longer kept, and the forest turns its face away.

entries.trigger: Path-switching cost: renouncing the active path (terminal Old Contract renunciation is the heaviest, but any path switch carries a one-time cost). Distinct from the gentle missed-cadence neglect.
entries.playerFacingText: You set down the path you walked. The road ahead is open, but what was earned does not follow you.

creedViolationLoss.designNote: No path other than Old Contract carries an item-level or compliance-meter creed loss. Exchange/Bandit Road/Living Story creed loss exists ONLY as the path-switch/renunciation cost. Bandit Road and Z'en/Exchange reject generic crime and generic commerce as triggers (manifest verifierExpectations).

currencyAndPace.model: event-gated bursty path signals (per PDV_Phase20BosmerNonHunterImplementationCosting.manifest.json). Each path advances on its curated path signals (routes 100-107), each anti-farmed with a once-per-day route key (Bandit Road reversal additionally seven-day cooldown). The small honest piety pulse goes to the path's SCORING DEITY (Yffre / Zen / BaanDar) so decay, neglect, and creed stay honest.
currencyAndPace.pace: Bursty, not a steady faucet: ~2 path signals per path. Expect slower-than-Nord progression to Devoted because Bosmer has sparse social hooks (cross-race balance flag) and event-gated bursts rather than per-kill scoring. Old Contract is the densest hooked path but is held back by Green Pact burden; the non-hunter paths reach comparable felt richness through recognition and distinctive favors, not faster pace.
currencyAndPace.rationale: One anti-farm mechanism per act (route once-per-day key for piety; no second substrate multiplier), per R8.

v1RecognitionSurface: Champion Survey/status text only (non-voiced). The Bosmer Survey reports the active path (OldContract/LivingStory/Exchange/BanditRoad), standing, Pact binding/lapse (PactBound/GreenPactCompliance/LapsedFromPact), recent favor memory, and non-hunter parity, WITHOUT raw favor counters (gate surveyStatusRequirement). T3 path recognition is Survey text only. Voiced NPC recognition (Pact reckoning, storytelling, debt settlement, pariah luck, Kynareth-as-Yffre proxy, Bosmer elder/story dialogue) is V2 per PDV_RecognitionDialogueScalePacket.md.
budget: Two always-on families only (R8): broad Y'ffre lane (Layer 1, capped at T2/Faithful) + ONE active path family (Layer 2: OldContract OR LivingStory OR Exchange OR BanditRoad, T1/T2/T3). Broad stays softer than the path family and is suppressed under a committed path. Green Pact is modest positive weighting, not a third boon family. At the PDV_RaceRewardBudgetLedger Bosmer ceiling: 'Old Contract can be strongest but must be narrow and burdensome. Other paths should have fewer hard costs but comparable felt richness through recognition, privileges, and distinctive momentary favors.' No magnitude exceeds ~12%.
